Reusable fd_tpu_reasm logic, slot queue helpers, and map accessors for tests.

# Purpose
`fd_tpu_reasm_private.h` defines shared internal helpers for the TPU transaction reassembly logic. It declares [`fd_tpu_reasm_reset`](<#fd_tpu_reasm_reset>) and provides inline functions to access reassembly slots, compute slot offsets, and read slot data and packet payloads from the data cache. The file also defines queue helpers for the LRU slot list, plus map helpers for insert, query, and remove operations on the reassembly key map. It is written as a private header so the same reassembly logic can be reused in normal code and in test cases.
